# Operations Manager — Repository Rules

- Keep this repository lightweight: Markdown files and existing Copilot/MCP tools only.
- Do not introduce scripts, Python, frameworks, extra agents, or new features without approval.
- Use Jira and Confluence MCP tools for external operations; do not invent retrieved facts.
- Before creating or modifying Jira or Confluence records, show a preview and request explicit approval.
- Confirm project, sprint, epic relationship, assignee, labels, and required Jira fields against live Jira data.
- Flag missing or ambiguous values instead of guessing.
- Keep responses concise, with issue links and outcomes after approved actions.
- Improve these Markdown instructions incrementally based on real usage.
